write_up: This is a strong transition resume! Your Army experience points clearly toward operations supervision, and you give a recruiter the numbers behind your leadership, equipment accountability, and maintenance work.

The vehicle readiness line is the model: it shows the change and the ordering and scheduling work behind it. Your progression from mechanic to platoon sergeant is easy to follow, and your supply chain degree is clearly marked as in progress.

Start by naming what the battalion's field logistics support included. Otherwise, your resume isn't the weak link here; the competition and how closely your experience matches a particular civilian job will still matter.
